_doc: Her pace while a press cast plays, by the angle between her travel and the aim (logic/Sim/CastMove.cs). fwd: share of her speed in the cone (absent: the record Walk, 0.7); cone: degrees either side of the aim; side: m/s cap at 90 deg; back: m/s cap at 180 deg; smoothstep between. A press record may carry its own castMove. Delete the castMove key for the old behavior. OFF since 10 Nov (A1 lead 20, the owner's demo-arpg1 note on her movement): the owner's game plays the heroine, whose legs never walk the cast's directions (the split clips run only on --body p1), so the cap lurched her from a run to a walk mid-swing. The block waits in castMoveOff: rename it back to castMove when a body that walks it ships.
